text:
olivia: Heads-up — onboarding sample-rerank using the shared embed helper is flaky. Sometimes the helper gets a field called `vector` with length 640, other times `embedding` with 1536. The matrix stack in rerank crashes. Anyone seen mixed responses like this?

sam: Oof. Which SDKs and aliases? paste the sanitized response if you can.

mike: Quick guess: SDK default alias drift + historical response key differences. Old node SDKs used `vector` for the compact embed. Newer server-side responses use `embedding` for the canonical shape.

olivia: Repro: curl to /v1/embeddings with model=open-embed-small (node sdk default) -> body: {"data":[{"id":"u1","vector":[/*640 floats*/]}]}. Python sample calls open-embed-large -> body: {"data":[{"id":"u1","embedding":[/*1536 floats*/]}]}. Rerank aggregator expects a single (batch,1536) matrix -> AssertionError in rerank/stacker.py:81.

rachel: Also saw earlier this week that the refresh-token retry path in node-sdk emits duplicate responses without an idempotency header, and our aggregator dedup is keyed by id+arrival-order. If the duplicate uses different field names (vector vs embedding) the normalization can pick the wrong one.

ci-bot: CI: samples/rerank-onboard-e2e #721 failed — rerank/stacker.py:81 AssertionError. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/721 (sanitized).

sam: Short-term mitigation: add a normalize_response(resp) helper that canonicalizes keys: prefer `embedding`, fallback `vector`, then `vec`. Convert everything to `embedding` before stacking. Also run pad_or_trim to expected_dim.

mike: We should also add a sanity check in the shared helper that raises a helpful error: "Embedding schema mismatch: alias open-embed-small -> expected 640 but reranker expects 1536. Confirm SDK alias parity or pick the large alias." That'll save folks time.

olivia: Patch idea: 1) samples: introduce embed_adapter.normalize_response + assert with human-friendly message; 2) SDKs: add alias-parity CI that calls each alias and records (field_name, dim); 3) server: canonicalize response key to `embedding` for all aliases (back-compat shims for older SDKs).

pat: I'll take the samples patch (normalize + assert). @sam can you own the SDK parity CI? We need an automated job in samples that fails if node/python/rust disagree on alias catalog.

sam: Yep — will add a job that runs small matrix: for alias in embed_aliases: call via node, call via py, record (field,dim). If mismatch push auto-issue with the diff.

rachel: For the retry/ordering problem, infra needs to ensure the token-refresh path replays original headers including x-idempotency-key and x-request-id. Filed infra ticket: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/301 (dedupe + retry header preservation).

ci-bot: Created ticket samples/issues/1103 for normalize_response patch and sample-app PR template update.

mike: One more gotcha — some older demos intentionally used open-embed-small to reduce tokens/costs. We should document that some aliases are compact (640) vs full (1536) and include a tiny snippet in onboarding showing how to assert expected length: `EXPECTED = 1536
if len(embedding) != EXPECTED:
    raise RuntimeError(f\"Embedding shape mismatch: expected {EXPECTED}, got {len(embedding)}\")`.

olivia: I'll land a minimal bump in sample-apps: samples/onboard/normalize-embed-key + README note about alias sizes. Pushed branch and referenced failing CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/1337 (WIP).

sam: Created SDK job and opened issue to track alias drift in SDK defaults: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-standards/issues/48.

pat: Thanks team — high ROI DX fixes. Short-term normalize + assert in samples, medium-term parity CI + server-side key canonicalization, and infra will handle retry header preservation.

olivia: Great, thanks. I'll drop the CI link in the PR and mark the demo as using open-embed-large by default until we finish the parity work. :thumbsup:
